export_evidence: No shipment row was visible on any trade-data source. ImportKey page for slug 'suru-international-pvt-ltd' returned only the paywalled shell: 'Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records of companies all over the world' — 0 rows actually seen (source counter: page claims 'Shipments available for SURU INTERNATIONAL PVT LTD, refreshed daily', rows displayed: 0). Second slug 'suru-international' gave the same 0-row shell. Volza, Eximpedia, Trademo returned HTTP 403; ImportGenius returned a JavaScript challenge. No bill-of-lading number, date, destination or HS code could be read.
domestic_evidence: Company website (suru.com/AboutUs) states: 'We supply to Fast Delivery SA in Health Medic brand' and 'Few of our Products are available online at Amazon and Flipkart for delivery within India.' This is a self-declaration only — no GST turnover band, no GeM/CPPP tender, no contract or annual-report split was retrievable (ZaubaCorp, TheCompanyCheck returned HTTP 403; search backend refused connections).
note: Legal identity corroborated from the company's own site footer: '© 2026 SURU INTERNATIONAL PRIVATE LIMITED CIN No: U33100MH1991PTC064643' (Maharashtra, 1991 incorporation). Declared HS 901832/901839/901890 (surgical needles, catheters, medical instruments) is consistent with the actual product range (medical disposable devices, ISO 13485:2016, CE marked, US FDA listed) — the claimed industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food/FMCG) is wrong and should be corrected to medical devices; per project rules this is not a rejection ground. Export activity is plausible (CE marking, OEM/OBL facility, 'Fast Delivery SA' partner) but NOT verified: no customs or B/L record was accessible, so export_status is unknown, not confirmed. Domestic supply likewise rests on website wording only — 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). No traces of shipments could be confirmed either way; this is an access limitation, not evidence of absence.
